  • CLAUDE.md: the sessions manager publishes releases (Edgar)

item.title: Version 0.3.0
item.description:
• CLAUDE.md: two more laws from repeated review findings (PRODUCTION is the union of every source; a failed read is never empty)
  • Workspaces: each saved member has its own id, so renaming or removing one of two alike sessions touches its own
  • Workspaces: All Sessions shows the open sessions, not Home
  • Layouts review fixes: broadcast remembers hosts seen as PRODUCTION through a vault lock (Exclude always leaves the held ones out), agent warnings under every terminal
  • Layouts review fixes: broadcast also holds a host saved as PRODUCTION now, the file list starts again with a new browser
  • Drop-down Console: each window keeps its own frame and level; the hot key stays while any window is a console
  • Layouts review fixes: workspaces.json saves apply only this app's changes (no queued replay), workspace items are known library items
  • Layouts review fixes: workspaces.json saves merge another ReSSH's changes, never write over a file that doesn't read (and unblock once it's moved), report a failed delete
  • Layouts review fixes: an unreadable workspaces.json that can't be moved aside is never saved over, Workspaces shows the selected session's workspace on entry
  • Layouts review fixes: newer unsaved workspace edits win over an older stash, an unreadable or duplicate-id workspaces.json is kept aside, never merged or saved over
  • Layouts review fixes: a workspace's saved list changes in one step, ticking a broadcast target never moves the keyboard into its terminal
  • Layouts review fixes: a tab in the broadcast line is typed as a space, a reload without a lock doesn't bring back workspaces deleted elsewhere
  • Layouts review fixes: starting broadcast puts the keyboard in its line, pending workspace edits survive a reload without a lock
  • Layouts review fix: the Files panel is made again for each session (its browser starts, no old selection); 380 points wide
  • Layouts review fixes: one vault item per workspace (another ReSSH's workspace isn't written over), a renamed tab's saved name follows
  • Layouts review fixes: no workspace saved while the vault keeps the hosts locked, a saved list clears the recovery stash; tests for an unreadable workspaces.json, a change between merge and clean-up, a repeated host
  • Layouts review fixes: broadcast holds a connection started as PRODUCTION, unreadable workspaces.json kept aside, merged bytes compared, Commander selection restored, repeated hosts matched by name
  • Layouts review fixes: unsaved workspaces stay pending until saved (lock, move out, restore), saved order follows the screen with sessions closed
  • Layouts review fixes: grid tabs take the keyboard whatever their files, workspaces follow drags and survive another app's move in, an empty workspace shows Home
  • Layouts review fixes: keyboard follows the selected session, reorders are one change, broadcast only into logged-in sessions, Commander downloads land on the left, unsaved workspaces survive a lock
  • Layouts: accentFill for filled pills, tab bar keeps its buttons whole, docs and debug switches for the new layouts
  • Tests: broadcast PRODUCTION hold, workspaces kept and reopened (vault too), files beside the terminal
  • Layouts: Session Rail, Drop-down Console, Commander, Broadcast Grid and Workspaces (⌃⌘4…⌃⌘8)
  • Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/fix/terminal-editor-review'
  • Terminal editor: a waiting edit opens synchronously, only while it's still being edited
  • Terminal editor: an editor in the queue that can't start doesn't stop the ones behind it
  • Terminal editor: vim or nano edits asked for while a sheet is up wait their turn and open when it quits
  • Terminal editor: a vim or nano that can't start says so in the browser instead of closing silently
  • Terminal editor: pastes honour bracketed paste or ask first; vim and nano start with ReSSH's settings, never the user's
  • Themes: Dracula, Catppuccin, Solarized, Gruvbox and Tokyo Night, and accentFill for accent-filled buttons
  • SFTP: Edit in vim or nano (Settings → Terminal), in a terminal sheet; saves go back through the same checks
  • Docs: releases run on this Mac; every doc and script comment says so, the GitHub Actions secrets are unused

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
• Release: verify-update reads codesign's output before matching (codesign | grep -q failed under pipefail when grep stopped early)
  • gitignore: .claude/ (session worktrees and local skills)
  • Tests: the throttle test checks the refusal says tooManyAttempts instead of reading the 2 s window afterwards (busy run missed it)
  • Releases run on this Mac: the GitHub Actions workflow is removed (Edgar: no CI on GitHub)
  • Tests: the cleanup test measures against the stall it must not wait out, not 3 s (a busy release runner took 3.25 s)
  • App icon: Tunnel a little larger, clipped to the tile (Edgar picked A)
  • Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/fix/release-test-hang'
  • App icon: Tunnel fills the whole tile (Edgar: "ship the tunnel too")
  • Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into claude/icon-brainstorm-8fbc0f
  • Release: build and test on GitHub's xcode-27 image with Xcode 27.1; Xcode 26's compiler never finishes SessionView.swift
  • Release secrets: test the releases token against both repos before storing it
  • Release secrets: strip Terminal's bracketed-paste markers and edge spaces from typed values (they made RELEASES_TOKEN an invalid header)
  • Icon: a full-tile Tunnel for review (Edgar: "full tile for ressh too")
  • Release: ReSSH's Sparkle public key (its private half is the SPARKLE_PRIVATE_KEY secret)
  • Vault: keep the user's lock-with-the-Mac choice under its own key, apart from the profile's
  • Settings: one fixed size for every tab; Vault locking settings; MDM (Intune) managed settings
  • Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/claude/mac-unlock'
  • Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/worktree-agent-ad85c16e6e6ba1ef5'
  • Release: push the version commit to main explicitly, whatever the local branch is
  • Mac unlock: any failure but a cancel drops the record, and the vault password is always offered
  • CLAUDE.md: two laws from repeated review findings (never hide the only way in; test timing vs the hang, not speed)
  • Mac unlock: a stale record (other signing key) is dropped, and a restored backup waits for the password
  • Release: a retry runs only from a checkout up to date with origin/main
  • Release: the feed never lists a draft update; untracked files stop a release
  • Release: only a Developer ID signed, notarized build with the app's update key, from the tagged commit, ships
  • Release: a reused zip must pass the appcast's EdDSA signature, not just its length
  • Release: retries in the same checkout reuse the prepared build and version commit
  • Release: publishing resumes after a failure at any step
  • Release: push the version commit and tag atomically
  • Auto-update with Sparkle 2 and a Developer ID release workflow, as in Remedio Mail
  • Vault: the data-protection message says to restart and unlock once, which moves the key to the new class
  • Vault: everyday unlock with Touch ID or the Mac password, like Passwords; the vault password only once per Mac
  • Vault device key: AfterFirstUnlockThisDeviceOnly, and an older key moves at the next password unlock
  • Vault unlock: a locked macOS data protection says what to do, not "OSStatus error -25308"
  • Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/claude/icon-brainstorm-8fbc0f'
  • Brainstorm page: the zoom overlay respects hidden (#zoom's display: grid overrode it, so it covered the page on load)
  • Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/claude/icon-brainstorm-8fbc0f'
  • App icon: Tunnel (Edgar's pick from round five) ships as design/icon/6-tunnel
  • Tests: test vaults never idle-lock; the askpass test watches only its own load's agent
  • Tests: askpass cancel and the live AI test hold up on a very busy run
  • Tests: test vaults ignore the Mac's idle time, and more waits tolerate a busy run
  • Tests: five timing tests tolerate a busy Mac (load ~400) and still prove what they guard
  • Icon brainstorm round five (Edgar): his five keepers (Tunnel, Porthole, Doorway, Glitch, Constellation) revised with liquid-glass-design, emil-design-eng, apple-hig-expert and color-expert behind the prototype skill's picker, each shown in every app theme (OKLab hue swap at the same lightness) and as a mono check; nine cute characters (six detailed, three strict ip-as-logo marks); 45 concepts, three per creativity technique
  • Icon brainstorm round four (Edgar via Skill master): one concept per claude-creativity technique, 15 in all, each labelled with its technique and how it shaped the idea
  • Icon brainstorm round three: four of Codex's concepts drawn (Home again, Return path, Saved place, Return to register)
  • Icon brainstorm round three (Edgar: zero creativity, reconnect with the logo inside the circle): Loop, Spin-up, Nested, Tunnel and Eclipse, where the Remedio logo's own frames and circle carry the meaning instead of a symbol on top
  • Icon brainstorm: six takes, not seven
  • Icon brainstorm round two: the ten new directions dropped (Edgar: all mocks suck); seven richer takes on #1 Prompt (lit cursor, glass lens, midnight neon, aurora, layered glass, brand gradient) and two Prompt × Reconnect merges, all on the unchanged Remedio mark
  • Icon brainstorm: a design critique score on each direction (idea, 16 px legibility, Remedio fit), Reconnect and R monogram called out as the strongest new ones
  • Icon brainstorm: ten new app icon directions beside #1 Prompt, at 1024/128/32/16 px in light and dark (design/icon/brainstorm.html, published as https://claude.ai/artifact/BRjZiaGH68sPq37N2C7oVj)
  • Handoff: state on 30 Oct 2026 (everything merged, Musts and PKI built), Edgar's latest decisions, all artifact links, push gate and next steps
  • Vault → Activity records sharing card changes: a colleague's card added (or replaced with new keys), marked checked or not, or removed in People, with the card's id and whether Microsoft verified it, never who (Edgar)
  • Gap analysis page: statuses after the Must and PKI build (48 have, 6 partial: built in ReSSH, server part with Pass stage 2), a Partial status, and a "Not built in ReSSH yet" filter; X.509 rows marked skipped (Edgar)
  • Each connection (tab or pane) gets its own ssh config, never one shared by host: a config rewritten for a second connection while the first's ssh or jump hop still read its own named the other's agent socket and files (gate review, medium). Recovery reads a backup like ReSSH's own backups do (a plain file, never through a link, up to 512 MiB, not 256), and says plainly when a file can't be read
  • Tests: the queue-limit test waits for its three downloads to reach the server before cancelling one
  • Tests: the download tests wait for the queue (a download is queued once the tab says which server it reaches) and for the running downloads to reach the server before it changes
  • SFTP: downloads, folder downloads and drags out to Finder are bound to the server the tab reached when they were asked for, like uploads: one still queued (or resumed) after the host was edited and reconnected elsewhere fails instead of fetching the same path from there (gate review, medium)
  • Host CAs: every change is made to the settings on disk under a lock (host-cas.lock), and known_hosts_cas is rewritten under it too, so a second window or ReSSH can't save over a revocation made in the first (gate review, medium)
  • Review fixes: Take Off never writes over a newer share record, a restore stops an import under way, shared use logged per hop, a shared key's passphrase copy logged
  • Vault → Activity: sharing in the credential log

  • Review fixes: two rotations at once keep a copy, a lock stops every rotation, no host saved into a vault the hosts left

  • Review fixes: a second ReSSH moving in after another did keeps that library, and reads the vault file first
  • Sharing: Send Update… and Take Off… seal to a colleague's current card once it was replaced and checked again (a new Mac, new keys)

  • Docs: shared credentials as built (SECURITY.md 11), why a shared secret can't be kept from the recipient's Mac and the stage-2 certificate broker (11.1, 11.2), the card and package byte formats (VAULT-FORMAT.md → Sharing), README Vault → Sharing
  • Vault → Sharing: your sharing card (Microsoft sign-in or a fingerprint to compare), People, Shared by me with Take Off… and Send Update…, shared folders; Share… on keys and logins, Import Share… in release builds
  • Review fixes: a failed save never takes in an older file, backup listing bounded, no environment tag while locked
  • Sharing, client side: a sharing identity and card per person, a Directory of colleagues' cards, ressh-share/2 packages (item key HPKE-sealed to each recipient, owner/recipient/role/item/revision in the AAD, signed), roles Use, Use and reveal, Manage enforced in VaultStore, revoke as a new revision, sharing events
  • Review fixes: a failed vault save never lingers in memory, restores leave plaintext hosts alone, the vault can't outgrow its backups

  • FIDO2 provider: only IOKit and CoreFoundation among system frameworks; export test covers every architecture
